title: Conventional Versus Modified Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy
brief_summary: In conventional laparoscopic cholecystectomy, the cystic duct and artery are clipped by metal clips. we propose a new method in which the cystic duct is ligated and the cystic artery is cauterized. the investigators compare both methods.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Laparoscopic cholecystectomy for symptomatic gallstones

Exclusion Criteria:

* Conversion to laparotomy
